notes.title: Announcement of Update V 1.1.2 for 《Joan of Arc》
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your inclusiveness and support, and for giving us feedback in a timely manner. At present, our development team has updated the version to V1.1.2. The main changes are as follows:
1. Fullscreen function has been added (F11 is the default hotkey, it is also in the options menu).
2. Steam's F12 and Shift+Tab shortcut keys have been fully integrated, you can upload screenshots!
3. Remove the skip function and accelerated the story's display

notes.title: V1.1.0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
In order to celebrate the release of Joan of Arc 170 days ago (the developer's name is pronounced similarly to 17 in their native language, so 17 is a lucky number), updated to version 1.1.0

This update adds a 170-day commemorative talisman: Luna Amulet (which coincides with the Mid-Autumn Festival in China) and Luna Amulet is divided into 3 levels. The specifics are as follows:
Luna Amulet Lv3: HP+3000, Atk+1000
Luna Amulet Lv4：HP+4500, Atk+1500
Luna Amulet Lv.5：HP+6000, Atk+2000
The Luna Amulet will fall on the 17th floor of the Tower of Babel. The drop rate is: Luna Amulet Lv3: 5%, Luna Amulet Lv4: 3%, Luna Amulet Lv5: 2%

I hope everyone can continue to support Tactics&Strategy Master: Joan of Arc and my other products!

notes.title: V1.0.27 Update Announcement
notes.content:
The update is as follows:
1. Because of an accident involving copying a few of the wrong files, the new version of the skills was delayed, but rest assured it's all still alright

2. According to a player's suggestion, I have moved the 'skip' button that fast forwards the plot to the bottom to avoid possible accidental clicking of it at the end of a battle

In addition, due to everyone's love and suggestions, the 《Tactics&Strategy Master》 series is ready to continue!

For details, please follow :
https://twitter.com/5771954fukusima 
@5771954Fukusima for updates and development news from time to time. If you like my project, please give me a review, I would very much like to get your support and feedback! Many thanks!
